methodSources.title: Berkshire Hathaway 1986 shareholder letter · owner earnings appendix
methodSources.principle: Consider cash required to maintain the business, including maintenance investment and necessary working capital. Total capital expenditure includes possible growth spending.

methodSources.title: Berkshire Hathaway 1992 shareholder letter · investment valuation
methodSources.principle: Consider long-term cash generation and uncertainty. Demand a margin between a conservatively estimated value and the price paid.

sources.title: Nasdaq Data Link · WIKI Prices (public domain)
sources.vintage: Discontinued source's archived observations, not an archived daily first-release feed.

design.selection: One established specialist retailer with public filings available before the first decision. Calendar 2017 is the last complete calendar year of the discontinued WIKI database. The case does not test stock selection across a universe.
design.review: Last NYSE session of each prior calendar quarter, 22:00 Eastern; execute at the next session opening print.
design.benchmark: Buy and hold the identical security from the first executable open. Apply identical cost, cash and fill conventions.
design.marketData: Raw USD opening and closing prices. Date/time stamps denote scheduled NYSE regular session boundaries. Feed documentation gives 21:15 Eastern as weekday update time; first-publication receipts per bar are unavailable.
design.corporateActions: All sampled WIKI ex-dividend fields are zero and split factors equal one. No adjustment required.
design.gapTreatment: Feed omits one regular session, November 8. Skip its valuation; no interpolation. No decision, fill or endpoint is on that date.
design.pretraining: Ticker, dates and source URLs can be withheld from model inputs. Recognition from public training data cannot be excluded.

evidence.label: Trailing 52-week revenue
evidence.formula: Prior filed 52 weeks plus current fiscal YTD minus the prior-year comparable YTD.

evidence.label: Trailing 52-week operating margin
evidence.formula: Prior filed 52 weeks plus current fiscal YTD minus the prior-year comparable YTD. Operating income divided by sales.

evidence.label: Trailing 52-week net income
evidence.formula: Prior filed 52 weeks plus current fiscal YTD minus the prior-year comparable YTD.

evidence.label: Trailing 52-week weighted average diluted shares (estimate)
evidence.formula: 52-week weighted share count bridged by fiscal YTD weeks; filed values are rounded.

evidence.label: Trailing 52-week diluted earnings per share (estimate)
evidence.formula: Bridged trailing net income divided by estimated trailing weighted average diluted shares.

evidence.label: Trailing 52-week cash from continuing operations
evidence.formula: Prior filed 52 weeks plus current fiscal YTD minus the prior-year comparable YTD. Reclassify the FY16 10-K's $63.731m financing tax benefit into CFO to match the 10-Q comparatives under ASU 2016-09.

evidence.label: Trailing 52-week capital spending, including growth spending
evidence.formula: Prior filed 52 weeks plus current fiscal YTD minus the prior-year comparable YTD.

evidence.label: Trailing 52-week free cash flow proxy; maintenance capex is undisclosed
evidence.formula: Prior filed 52 weeks plus current fiscal YTD minus the prior-year comparable YTD. Reclassify the FY16 10-K's $63.731m financing tax benefit into CFO to match the 10-Q comparatives under ASU 2016-09. Operating cash flow less total purchases of property and equipment.
